question: The LCM of 2³times 7²times 12, 2²times 12²times 18 and 7³times 12²times 18²is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the LCM, express all terms in their prime factor form and multiply the highest powers of each prime factor.

1st number = 2³ × 7² × 12 = 2⁵ × 3¹ × 7²

2nd number = 2² × 12² × 18 = 2⁷ × 3⁴

3rd number = 7³ × 12² × 18² = 2⁶ × 3⁶ × 7³

LCM = Max(2⁵, 2⁷, 2⁶) × Max(3¹, 3⁴, 3⁶) × Max(7², 1, 7³) = 2⁷ × 3⁶ × 7³

**∴ The correct answer is 2⁷ × 3⁶ × 7³.**
